name: SSG Crypto Swap Widget
author: safeswapglobal

sections.description:
SSG Crypto Swap Widget enables your website visitors to execute fast, non-custodial cryptocurrency swaps directly from your pages.

Features:
* Instant Swaps: Bitcoin (BTC), Monero (XMR), Solana (SOL), Toncoin (TON), Tether (USDT).
* Zero Registration: No accounts, no KYC required.
* Dual Themes: Supports both dark and light styling.
* 100% Non-Custodial: Direct wallet-to-wallet settlement.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the zip file via ‘Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin’ in WordPress.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Use shortcode [ssg_widget] in any post, page, or widget area.

Example:
[ssg_widget from=”sol” to=”usdt” theme=”light”]
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial release with distinctive branding and multi-chain routing.
